meta.tagline: Football match probabilities from a statistical model, with every prediction scored in public.
meta.description: Match probabilities for 1X2, goals and both teams to score from a Dixon-Coles model. Every prediction is settled and published, wins and losses alike.

footer.dataSourceText: Fixtures, results and odds are supplied by third-party data providers and may lag live events. Probabilities come from our own statistical model.
footer.responsibleText: Predictions are probabilities, not guarantees. Nothing on this site is betting advice. If you gamble, only stake what you can afford to lose. 18+.

common.emptyLead: There is no data for this selection. Try a different date or league.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.lead: The page could not be loaded. This is usually temporary.
errors.notFoundLead: The address may be wrong or the page has moved.

home.title: Probabilities, not promises.
home.lead: A Dixon-Coles model rates every fixture in the leagues it is trained on. Each prediction is settled after the final whistle and published, whether it won or lost.
